tests: R124 (G12b) a first load of a session asks the six frame reads at once, once each, as always; the tab then keeps them
R124 (G12b) the store holds the six reads' answers and no token, no route, no read of a screen (R24): control

R124 (G12b, G81) a second page load in the session sends none of the six frame reads before the screen's reads have settled, and asks the four that can change once after (the two constants not at all)
R124 (G12b) a second page load whose reads never settle never asks the six; the kept ones are all it draws
R124 (G12b, G81) the frame follows an answer that differs from what the tab kept: the assistant goes, the name (kept over a day) changes
R124 (G12b) a kept read the screen itself read in this load is not asked again, and the frame takes the screen's answer
R125 (G12b) the guide's marks are asked with the screen's first read (within 50 ms, the read still out), once, and the marks draw from that answer
R125 (G12b) the marks answered long before the route settles are still handed to entered (past the load and the 5 seconds); control: a later route asks for its own
R125 (G12b) the marks are not asked for a route the guide draws no marks for: no session, and a guide that does not read wizardsat
R122 (G12b) bootstrap is sent after the screen's first read and the marks request, never before them; one still out blocks neither the screen nor its marks
R124 (G12b) a different member in the same tab sees none of the first member's values; nor does the same member under another session
R124 (G12b) storage unavailable renders correctly: a sessionStorage that denies every use, one that holds rubbish, one that holds another's
R124 (G12b) sign-out, a lock and a new sign-in clear what the tab kept
R124 (G12b) the member's own change of the level is not kept: the next load asks infolevel before the screen settles
R124 (G12b) a kept read that does not answer when it is asked again keeps what it held, and is not asked again in the page
R124 (G12b) control: a page with a screen whose reads fail still asks the six on a first load, together (no wait for another)
